question: If 1 is added to each odd digit and 2 is subtracted from each even digit in the number 6437585, how many digits will appear more than once in the new number thus formed?
solution:

The rules for transformation are:

 
• For each odd digit: Add 1 (+ 1)
 
• For each even digit: Subtract 2 (- 2)
